title: Clueing up LLMs with Tool-Augmented Deductive Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.18736v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite recent advances in large language models (LLMs), performing logically consistent deductive reasoning over extended interactions remains challenging. Tasks that require integrating evidence across multiple reasoning steps, maintaining consistency with prior inferences, and updating beliefs under new constraints can surface limitations in current models while providing a useful testbed for evaluating reasoning enhancements. In this paper, we implement a text-based, multi-agent version of the classic board game Clue as an environment to evaluate multi-step, agentic deductive reasoning. In this setting, agents must infer hidden information from a sequence of observations, maintain consistency across turns, and reason over an evolving set of logical constraints. translated_title: 用工具增强的演绎推理为大型语言模型提供线索
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）近期取得了进展，但在长时间交互中执行逻辑一致的演绎推理仍然具有挑战性。那些需要在多个推理步骤中整合证据、保持与先前推理的一致性、并在新约束条件下更新信念的任务，能够暴露当前模型的局限性，同时也为评估推理增强方法提供了有用的测试平台。在本文中，我们实现了经典桌面游戏Clue（妙探寻凶）的基于文本的多智能体版本，作为评估多步智能体演绎推理的环境。在该环境中，智能体必须从一系列观察中推断隐藏信息，在各轮次之间保持一致性，并对不断演变的逻辑约束集合进行推理。我们实例化了六个基于LLM的智能体（GPT-4o-mini和Gemini-2.5-Flash）作为玩家参与回合制游戏；每个模型家族使用三个智能体，我们建立了基线……（摘要原文不完整，此处为可翻译部分）
tldr: 本文将经典桌游Clue改造为基于文本的多智能体回合制游戏环境，用以评估大语言模型在工具增强下的多步演绎推理能力。
